tools.name: find_destinations
tools.description: Suggest 3-5 destinations for a trip mood or constraint set, e.g. "somewhere warm in November, food-first". Use when the traveller has not settled on a place yet.

tools.name: destination_brief
tools.description: A short brief on one destination: what it is like, typical weather now, official safety verdict. Use before or instead of a full itinerary.

tools.name: top_spots
tools.description: The strongest real places in a destination — top attractions by default, or a specific ask like "specialty coffee" or "rooftop bars". Real Google-rated places, never invented.

tools.name: build_itinerary
tools.description: Build a day-by-day itinerary for a destination from its strongest real places. Returns the plan plus links to run it as a group trip on Instafan.

tools.name: spot_photos
tools.description: Real photos of one spot — up to two shown inline plus direct photo links. Name a specific place ("Belém Tower") or leave spot empty for a postcard of the destination itself.
